_note: Hand-authored fixture (NOT generated by a script — edit directly; expected outputs WERE cross-checked by running the real findTransitiveParentCompounds/findAffectedBoardIds/computeBoardStatsUpdate once during authoring). Exercises packages/shared/src/algorithms/derivationPass.ts from both sides: packages/shared/tests/algorithms/derivationPass.test.ts runs these through the shared TS functions; apps/ios/OYBCTests/DerivationPassVectorTests.swift runs the SAME vectors through iOS's Swift mirror DerivationPass in Services/DerivationPass.swift. Both must agree for every vector. Minimal shapes: task={id,type,isCompleted,isDeleted,operator,threshold,referencedBoardId,referencedTemplateId,achievementTrigger,requiredCount} (fields unused by a given type are null); board={id,boardSize,centerSquareType,startDate,endDate(nullable — null models an INDEFINITE host's unbounded upper window),status,linesCompleted,completedLineIds(nullable),isDeleted,spawnedFromTemplateId}; boardTask={taskId,row,col}; compoundChild={compoundTaskId,childTaskId,isDeleted}. computeBoardStatsUpdate vectors carry `board` (the board being evaluated), `boardTasksOnBoard`, `childrenByCompound`, `taskById`, `allBoards` (Phase 6.3 cross-board context), and `expected` (boardId/completedTasks/linesCompleted/completedLineIds/newBingos/lostBingos). This fixture covers the FULL derivationPass.test.ts vector surface — no cases were left hand-written on the shared side (see C1 report for the exact per-file replaced-vs-kept split). Bingo-pipeline hardening additions: (a) duplicate-placement/out-of-range vectors pin the computeBoardGrid guards (completedTasks counts per CELL — a cell greens once no matter how many placements land on it — and row/col >= boardSize placements are skipped, never aliased); (b) windowed vectors carry an OPTIONAL `windowContext` key ({eventsByTaskId: {taskId: [{kind, occurredAt, delta?, isDeleted?}]}}) — absent means lifetime resolution (the historical behavior of every pre-existing vector), present means the consumer builds a WindowEvaluationContext from it (filling TaskEvent boilerplate: id/userId/timestamps/version; isDeleted defaults false) and passes it to computeBoardStatsUpdate, so the windowed seam (phantom-bingo class) is pinned cross-platform. Windowed tasks may also carry optional maxCount/currentCount/sharedCounterId.
